routing.title: One owner. Help when it matters.
routing.label: THE WORKING RULE

start.label: Start with your outcome
start.detail: One skill owns the result and takes the simplest path that can deliver it.

branches.label: Need separate expertise?
branches.detail: Bring in one skill for the specific question or check. The original owner keeps the task.

branches.label: Decision changes scope?
branches.detail: You make the call. The agent can keep working on what you already authorized.

finish.label: Get a result you can trust
finish.detail: Report what changed, what the checks proved, and any material limits.

example.title: A slow export, traced to a fix
example.label: ILLUSTRATIVE RUN
example.prompt: The CSV export times out on 10,000 rows. Fix it without changing the output.

steps.label: Debug
steps.detail: Reproduce the timeout and trace one database query per row.

steps.label: Code
steps.detail: Use the SQL guide to shape a batched read that preserves row order and duplicates.

steps.label: Test
steps.detail: Rerun the same fixture. Verify the timeout is gone and compare the CSV byte for byte.

example.report: Removed the repeated queries. The 10,000-row fixture completes within its timeout and exports identical bytes.
